sources.title: Lower Bounds for Regular Resolution over Parities
sources.version: ECCC TR23-187, revision 2, 2024-09-24; STOC 2024 and SIAM Journal on Computing 54(4), 2025
sources.scope: Regular bit-PHP size lower bound 2^{Omega(n^{1/3}/log n)}; unrestricted affine-width lower bound, not an unrestricted superpolynomial size bound.

sources.title: Lower Bounds for Bit Pigeonhole Principles in Bounded-Depth Resolution over Parities
sources.locator: Abstract, Introduction, and Section 3.3 encoding; distinguish the ECCC earlier version from arXiv v1
sources.scope: Depth-restricted bit-PHP size lower bounds, including the usual n+1-pigeon instance.

sources.title: Lower Bounds for Near-Quadratic-Depth Resolution over Parities
sources.locator: Official proceedings abstract under the exact paper title; author publication pages identify the merger
sources.scope: Exponential lower bounds at proof depth O(n^{2-epsilon}) for n+1 pigeons and n holes. The direct DOI retrieval failed; the official abstract and author records were available.

sources.title: Resolution Width Lifts to Near-Quadratic-Depth Res(oplus) Size
sources.locator: Introduction page 2, rule definition and open-problem statement; abstract and Section 1.2 for unrestricted polynomial size bounds
sources.scope: General superpolynomial Res(parity) size lower bounds explicitly remain open; unrestricted result here is quadratic. Rules match complementary-parity resolution plus semantic weakening.

sources.title: Chessboard Complexes and Matching Complexes
sources.version: Journal of the London Mathematical Society 49 (1994), 25-39
sources.scope: The exact connectivity formula yields vanishing of reduced H_{s-2} for N>=2s-1, used in the existing matching extension proof.

sources.title: On the strength of Sherali-Adams and Nullstellensatz as propositional proof systems
sources.locator: Definition 4.11 and proof of Corollary 4.12, printed page 18
sources.scope: Explicit unary-variable-to-bit-label-conjunction substitution and polynomial derivations of the substituted pigeon axioms; cited as prior use of the standard reduction.
